quests.explanation: Not able to be trusted or depended on is unreliable, the reverse of reliable.

quests.explanation: Reliable means you can count on it; unreliable, its opposite, means you can't.

quests.explanation: Rigid is right here — it means unable to change or adapt easily, the opposite of flexible.

quests.explanation: Exactly — secretive. It means unwilling to share information, keeping things hidden, the opposite of transparent.

quests.hint: This is someone who keeps whispering and hiding their phone screen.
quests.explanation: Unwilling to share information is secretive, the reverse of transparent.
quests.textToSpeak: The company was *transparent* about the data breach.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Call to mind a government that keeps its decisions locked away from the public.
quests.explanation: Transparent means open and honest about information; secretive, its opposite, means keeping it hidden.
quests.textToSpeak: Good doctors stay *transparent* with patients about treatment options.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.

quests.explanation: Inefficient is the word here — it means wasting time or resources, the opposite of efficient.
quests.textToSpeak: The new ticket system at the cinema is much more *efficient*.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: It's a machine that uses far more energy than it needs to.
quests.explanation: Solid answer. Wasting time or resources is inefficient, the reverse of efficient.
quests.textToSpeak: A dishwasher is more *efficient* than washing everything by hand.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Picture an office where every task gets done twice by mistake.
quests.explanation: Efficient means using time and resources well; inefficient, its opposite, means wasting them.
quests.textToSpeak: Our school adopted a more *efficient* way to grade assignments.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.

quests.hint: That's diving into unfamiliar water without checking the depth first.
quests.explanation: Acting without thinking about danger is reckless, the reverse of cautious.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.

quests.hint: This is a painting made to look like the work of a famous artist.
quests.explanation: Not real, made to imitate something else, is fake, the reverse of genuine.

quests.explanation: Genuine means truly real; fake, its opposite, means made to only look that way.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.

quests.explanation: Arrogant is correct — it means having an exaggerated sense of your own importance, the opposite of humble.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: It's a coworker who takes all the credit for a team project.
quests.explanation: Correct. An exaggerated sense of your own importance is arrogant, the reverse of humble.
quests.textToSpeak: The award-winning actor gave a *humble* thank-you speech.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.
quests.hint: Picture someone who looks down on anyone less successful than them.
quests.explanation: Humble means modest about your own abilities; arrogant, its opposite, means overly proud of them.
quests.textToSpeak: My grandfather is *humble* about all his years of hard work.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.

quests.explanation: Tolerant means open to different views; intolerant, its opposite, means closed off to them.

quests.instruction: Speak the opposite of the highlighted word.

quests.explanation: Pessimistic is right here — it means expecting the worst outcome, the opposite of optimistic.

quests.hint: It's expecting the worst possible outcome before you even try.
quests.explanation: Expecting the worst outcome is pessimistic, the reverse of optimistic.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor stayed *optimistic* about the patient's full recovery.

quests.hint: Picture a forecaster who only ever predicts storms and bad news.
quests.explanation: Optimistic means expecting good things; pessimistic, its opposite, means expecting the worst.
